responseMessageContents.text: They don't need to contact the Rork team for this—it was a bug in the app's code that I've already fixed, so I should just explain simply what happened and that it's resolved.  Since I got it wrong a couple times before, I want to be upfront about that and give them the one clear action: install v1.10.25 and test the recording feature themselves so they can verify it's actually working now.

No — you don't need to call anyone. This is a bug inside your app's own code, and I have full access to it. Nothing here needs Rork support.

**In plain terms, what was wrong:** your app has a "front door" screen (`/`) whose only job was to instantly forward you to Home or Login. But it was built to draw *nothing at all* while it forwarded. If that forward didn't complete — which happens when the login check is still finishing, or when two forwards collide — you were left staring at an empty dark screen. No error, no crash, nothing to report. That's exactly the 14 seconds of black your video captured.

**The fix:** that screen now always shows the IVX logo and a loading line while it forwards. It's structurally impossible for it to be empty now — even if the forward never completes, you see a real screen instead of black.

**Why it took three tries, honestly:** v1.10.23 removed a broken route but added a watchdog that falsely accused a *working* Home. v1.10.24 fixed that false alarm, but its recovery button sent you into `/` — the very screen that renders nothing. v1.10.25 fixed the actual black screen. I also added a build-time rule that would have caught this the first time, so it can't come back.

**What I need from you — one thing:**

Install **v1.10.25** and use it normally.
https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/releases/download/v1.10.25-qa/ivx-holdings-v1.10.25.apk

Check the version at the bottom of the screen reads `1.10.25 (123)` so we know it's the right build. If you see black again, record it and send the video — I can now trace the exact second to the exact screen.
